From: Samantha Lee <samantha@acme-analytics.com>
To: pricing@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in pricing + demo (pricing CTA)

Hi Redwood team,

I filled out the pricing CTA form on your site — we're evaluating inference platforms for production use at Acme Analytics. We have a couple of initial questions and would love to schedule a short demo to see latency/cost tradeoffs and deployment options (particularly private/VPC).

A few details about us:
- Use case: real-time personalization and batch reranking
- Expected QPS: 50-200 depending on workload
- Security: SOC2 and cloud-region requirement (US)
- Budget: we have an initial allocation and would like pricing for both hosted and dedicated capacity

Could someone on the sales team schedule a 30-minute call this week? My calendar is flexible after 1pm PT.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director of ML Platforms
Acme Analytics
